claim: further work tied that to Tribidrag, documented in Croatian records from the early sixteenth century
because: Tribidrag is documented in the fifteenth century, not the sixteenth. The name appears in 1444 in a record by don Juraj Radičević, priest at Vodice in Dalmatia. The same grape appears earlier still, as Cratosia (Kratošija), in the Statute of Budva of 1426–1442.
fix: further work tied that to Tribidrag, documented in Dalmatian records from the fifteenth century (1444)
